tools.name: truein_list_employees
tools.description: List staff master records (employee id, name, status, manager). Use status=active to see current staff. Truein GET /apis/ext/attendance/v1.0/getEmployeeDtls.

tools.name: truein_list_punch_pairs
tools.description: List clock-in and clock-out punch pairs for all staff, 1000 records per call. Send lastUid=0 first, then the uid of the last record for the next page. Filters on the clock-in time. Truein GET /apis/ext/attendance/v1.0/inOutDtls.

tools.name: truein_get_daily_attendance_log
tools.description: Get the attendance log for one day: who was present, absent or late. Paginated by lastUid (send 0 first). Truein GET /apis/ext/attendance/v1.0/dailyAttendanceLog.

tools.name: truein_get_punch_log
tools.description: Get raw punch records (each clock event) for a time window or employee. Paginated by lastUid. Truein GET /ext/v1/time-tracking/getPunchLog.

tools.name: truein_get_timesheet_summary
tools.description: Get the hours worked per employee for a date range, optionally with leave split and job-wise totals. Truein GET /ext/v1/timesheet/getTimesheetSummary.

tools.name: truein_get_leave
tools.description: List leave requests with their approval status for a site or employee. Truein GET /ext/v1/leave/getLeave.

tools.name: truein_get_leave_lite
tools.description: List leave-lite requests (short leave) with approval status. Truein GET /ext/v1/leave/getLeaveLite.

tools.name: truein_get_schedule
tools.description: Get who is scheduled on which shift and job for a date at a site. Paginated. Truein GET /ext/v1/schedule/getSchedule.

tools.name: truein_get_shifts
tools.description: List shift definitions (code, name, start and end times) for a site. Truein GET /ext/v1/shift/getShifts.

tools.name: truein_get_client_sites
tools.description: List sites (work locations) with their codes. Truein GET /ext/v1/client-site/getClientSites.

tools.name: truein_get_regions
tools.description: List regions that group sites. Truein GET /ext/v1/region/getRegions.

tools.name: truein_get_public_holidays
tools.description: List public holidays for a year or a date. Truein GET /ext/v1/holiday/getPublicHoliday.

tools.name: truein_get_geofencing_locations
tools.description: List the geofenced locations used for GPS attendance at a site. Truein GET /ext/v1/geofencing-location/getGeoFencingLocations.

tools.name: truein_get_spoof_punches
tools.description: List punches that Truein flagged as possible spoofing (for example a photo held up to the camera). Truein GET /ext/v1/alerts/getSpoofPunches.

tools.name: truein_get_kiosk_devices
tools.description: List the kiosk (punch device) records for a site. Truein GET /ext/v1/kiosk-device/getKioskDevice.

tools.name: truein_get_punch_checklist_answers
tools.description: Get the answers staff gave to the punch checklist questions for a date. Truein GET /ext/v1/timesheet/getPunchChecklistAnswers.

tools.name: truein_clock_in
tools.description: WRITE: record a clock-in punch for an employee at a site, at the given time. Truein POST /v1/time-tracking/clockIn. Geofenced sites may reject a punch without a photo or location.

tools.name: truein_clock_out
tools.description: WRITE: record a clock-out punch for an employee at a site, at the given time. Truein POST /v1/time-tracking/clockOut.

tools.name: truein_request_leave
tools.description: WRITE: submit a leave-lite request for an employee for the given dates. The request then waits for approval. Truein POST /ext/v1/leave/addLeaveLite.

tools.name: truein_cancel_leave_request
tools.description: WRITE: cancel a leave-lite request for an employee on the given dates. Truein POST /ext/v1/leave/cancelLeaveLiteStatus.
